name: 15152-basetraffic-7b-1gpu
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query and 32 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, max_position_embeddings 4096, fp16, 6.74B params (13.5 GB).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 200 requests / 1200 s safety, warmup 10% and cooldown 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets and no shared prefix. Prompt EXACTLY 2048 tokens and output EXACTLY 512 tokens (min = max on both, and the backend sets ignore_eos with max_tokens), so every request is one 2048-token prefill plus 512 decode steps.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter chat assistant drafting fixed-length replies from long documents for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Serve invocation for this item.

model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 16
max-lora-rank: 64
enforce-eager: true
# Load-bearing for the workload: the same prompt shape is sent repeatedly and every request must
# be a real 2048-token prefill rather than a cache hit.
enable-prefix-caching: false
disable-log-requests: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
